title: Evidence-Based Credit Assignment for Search-Augmented Language Models
first_author_affiliation: University of the Chinese Academy of Sciences / Tencent
code_status: 固定v1及所核作者入口未找到可验证的本篇方法源码发布；所用模型、训练库不算本篇开源。

cost_assessment.basis: §4使用Qwen2.5-3B/7B、8192训练题、256更新×256轨迹=65536条轨迹/运行；Wikipedia18/E5检索服务、七测试集51713题、多方法与迁移对照。完整训练/检索评测超出本轮单卡秒级组件预算。
cost_assessment.available_resource: Single NVIDIA A100/A30 or local Mac
cost_assessment.decision: Full experiment not reproduced due to high cost; review DONE. No checkpoint/data download or paid API.

summary: 终止答案全错时，组相对奖励为零，但检索可能已经取得有价值证据。ECA用训练专用冻结策略在仅含问题与去重文档的上下文中，计算参考答案的长度归一化对数似然势函数；生成的思考、查询和其他轨迹不参与打分。 固定G=8、H=3的势函数suffix return、对侧fold样本标准差/0.25 floor、novelty gate、search-local token advantage及无ratio clip的序列求和策略损失。冻结scorer打分、检索器和完整LLM训练未实现。
local_command: PYTHONPATH=src python -c 'from auto_research.post_training.eca_credit import diagnostic; print(diagnostic(42))'
